requirement_text.REQ-044: Pure transition kernel core types and dispatch skeleton (transition.zig, EE-02) -- no Ecto.Repo call, no I/O of any kind, no clock read. result.summary: Scope test run against git diff main...HEAD (full branch diff, 12 files). Application-code changes are exactly the 3 files named in context.artifacts_in plus their design doc: lib/letflow/engine/token.ex, lib/letflow/engine/instance_state.ex, lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex, lib/letflow/design/req044-transition-kernel.md; the remaining changed files are docs/requirements.yaml, docs/status/requirement_status.yaml, handoffs/**, none of which are code. Checked against the 5 scope-test conditions in .claude/agents/security-reviewer.md: (1) API route reading/writing tenant-scoped data -- none; `git diff --name-only` has zero files matching router/plug/controller. (2) priv/repo/migrations/*.exs migration -- none; `git diff --stat -- priv/repo/migrations/` is empty. (3) anything resolving a secret (config/env var/token) -- none; no config/ or runtime.exs changes, no System.get_env call added. (4) response-shaping code for a tenant-scoped entity -- none; these 3 modules are plain in-memory structs (Letflow.Engine.Token, Letflow.Engine.InstanceState) and a pure dispatch function (Letflow.Engine.Transition.transition/3), never serialized to an HTTP response in this diff. (5) lookup-by-ID handler -- none; find_token/2 and find_node/2 are private in-memory list scans over caller-supplied arguments, not a network-facing lookup-by-ID endpoint. Ran `grep -nE "Repo\.|Ecto\.|tenant_id|prefix|System\.get_env|Plug\.|HTTPoison|Req\.|:httpc" lib/letflow/engine/token.ex lib/letflow/engine/instance_state.ex lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex` -- every hit is inside a moduledoc/comment describing what the module deliberately does NOT do ("Plain struct, not an Ecto.Schema", "No alias Letflow.Repo, no import Ecto.Query"), none is executable code invoking Repo/Ecto/tenant_id/prefix/a secret/Plug/HTTP. No new/changed migration exists to check under INV-1(b)/(c). Verdict: out of scope -- no tenant-data path touched. Per WF-02 Step 2c and the role file's scope test, INV-1..INV-8 are therefore not individually run against this diff (the scope test itself is the applicable check, and it says NO).
